title: Ask/answer HMI questions during OptiSweep Day 1 training Q&A
summary: Use the HMI-focused Q&A follow-up segment as a lightweight, operator-led way to raise and resolve questions about what the HMI is showing/controlling during live system use. The source segment only confirms that participants have “more questions about the HMI” and does not provide legible, screen-specific HMI controls or fields.
when_to_use: When you have an HMI question during the OptiSweep Day 1 training Q&A follow-up and need a quick clarification so you can proceed with your next HMI-related task.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for screen-specific troubleshooting when the HMI screen/controls you need are not identified or are not readable.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: identify the specific HMI topic you need clarified, ask the question, and confirm you understand enough to proceed with the next HMI task.
Trainer/attendees (during training): provide clarification for the HMI topic being asked.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the HMI training session (trainer/attendees)
Ability to view the HMI screen(s) referenced during training (if shown)

visual_references.description: HMI Q&A follow-up frame reference; OCR is only 'x' (low legibility).

steps.title: Identify the specific HMI topic you have questions about
steps.purpose: So the Q&A can focus on the exact HMI topic you need clarified.
steps.instruction: During the HMI Q&A portion of the OptiSweep Day 1 training, identify the specific HMI topic you have questions about (the segment explicitly indicates participants have “more questions about the HMI”).
steps.expected_result: You have a specific HMI topic ready to ask (not just a general question about the HMI).
steps.healthy_condition: Your question is specific enough that it can be answered as an HMI clarification during the Q&A.
steps.failure_condition: Your question is too vague to be answered, or you cannot identify what part of the HMI you mean.

actions.label: State the HMI topic
actions.exact_action: Identify the specific HMI topic you have questions about

steps.title: Ask the question and wait for HMI-related clarification
steps.purpose: Obtain clarification for the HMI topic you identified.
steps.instruction: Ask your question to the trainer/attendees and wait for the HMI-related clarification.
steps.expected_result: You receive an HMI-related clarification that addresses your specific question.
steps.healthy_condition: The clarification directly answers your question about what the HMI is showing/controlling for your topic.
steps.failure_condition: The question cannot be answered from the Q&A segment, or the HMI screen/controls you need are not identifiable/readable.

actions.label: Ask the HMI question
actions.exact_action: Ask the question to the trainer/attendees and wait for the HMI-related clarification

stop_or_escalate_if: If the HMI screen content is not readable or the question cannot be answered from this segment, request additional HMI training time or a different segment that shows the specific HMI screen/controls.

steps.title: Confirm you understand enough to proceed with your next HMI task
steps.purpose: Ensure you can proceed without misunderstanding the HMI topic you asked about.
steps.instruction: After the clarification, confirm you understand what the HMI is showing/controlling well enough to proceed with your next HMI task in training.
steps.expected_result: You can explain (to yourself) what the HMI is indicating for your topic well enough to proceed.
steps.healthy_condition: You are confident you can continue with the next HMI task without needing further clarification for the same topic.
steps.failure_condition: You still do not understand what the HMI is showing/controlling for your topic, or you cannot proceed safely/accurately.

actions.label: Verify understanding
actions.exact_action: Confirm you understand what the HMI is showing/controlling well enough to proceed with your next HMI task

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confirm understanding, request additional HMI training time or a different segment that shows the specific HMI screen/controls.

success_criteria: You leave the HMI Q&A with clarified understanding of the specific HMI topic you asked about.
You can proceed with your next HMI task in training without needing further clarification for that topic.
healthy_conditions: Your HMI question is specific and receives an HMI-related clarification during the Q&A.
You can confirm understanding and proceed with the next HMI task.
failure_conditions: The HMI screen content is not readable/identifiable (OCR unreadable) and the question cannot be answered from the segment.
You cannot confirm understanding well enough to proceed with the next HMI task.
escalation_guidance: Request additional HMI training time or a different segment that shows the specific HMI screen/controls when the current Q&A segment does not provide enough legible, screen-specific information.
